conclusion_zh: 跨语言检索断路已修复：纯中文问题从历史检索不到英文论文，变为两组都能取得 8 条原文证据并真实调用 Step-5。但是本轮仍没有实际辅助支持项进入任何 ON 回答，不能宣称类比、演绎、归纳或后台辅助提高了质量。ON 均分的 +3.65 分只是本轮描述性波动，平均 token 和回答耗时反而略增；材料覆盖和来源归属仍有缺口。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization

method.output_cap_scope: Experimental max_tokens=8192 overrides the unchanged product default 2048. This is not a measurement of default-cap production performance.
method.version_scope: These receipts belong only to the frozen v2 fingerprint and e5-local-window-v1. Later source-window/index changes use a different implementation and are not evaluated by this report.
controls: Pinned original PDFs only; no answer notes, synthetic causal rules or benchmark facts ingested.
Equivalent frozen corpus clones and empty history in each pair; memory, self-evolution and application response cache disabled.
Same local multilingual retriever, source budget, model and generation parameters in OFF and ON; only the optional background helper differs.
All 13 pairs have byte-for-byte equal structured supplied source lists; this was checked independently from answer artifacts.
Serial calls with alternating first arm, six OFF-first and six ON-first primary pairs.
Documents warmed separately per storage namespace; queries not pre-encoded or cache-warmed.
No automatic retry or silent provider/model switch.
method.provider_cache_control: Vendor prompt caching was not disabled. Ten of twelve main pairs have unequal reported cached-token counts; equal counts in the other two do not prove matching cache state.

quality_method.basis: Semantic required-fact checks against pinned papers plus material citation checks against the actual S-number excerpts, not keyword overlap.
quality_method.blinding: Random candidate labels; reviewers saw question, paper-grounded scoring notes and supplied excerpts, but not arm labels, timings, usage or helper traces.
quality_method.averaging: One generation per arm per question; twelve questions equally weighted.

method.data_scope: This reuses a four-paper development benchmark whose earlier failures informed fixes. It is not held-out evaluation or proof of generalization.

quality.critical_error_caution: Zero rubric critical flags in this small AI review is not a guarantee that all facts or citations are correct.

exposure.interpretation: Nine no-exposure controls account for 31.25 of the 43.75 summed score points. Zero actual support and only three hint-only pairs do not identify an algorithmic reasoning benefit; temperature zero also did not make repeated identical prompts deterministic.

off.availability_definition: ready means the recorded retrieval operation ran; it does not establish relevant evidence or answer quality

on.availability_definition: ready means the recorded retrieval operation ran; it does not establish relevant evidence or answer quality

all_v2_provider_consumption.definition: All provider-reported consumption, including failed or truncated attempts. Not currency charges; unknown usage is not zero. Separate from successful matched-pair averages.

consumption.scope: Only this v2 run. Does not replace or merge the historical 48-call main experiment, previous pilots, or later window experiments. Vendor token receipts are not currency charges. Blind AI reviews are not Step-5 API calls and are outside product runtime measurements.
consumption.reasoning_token_caution: The provider reports zero reasoning tokens; this does not demonstrate absence of internal model reasoning.

latency_definition: Wall-clock pre-model, full non-streaming HTTP model call, post-model and total answer; not first-token latency. New runs exclude PDF ingestion, corpus cloning and document-vector prewarm from the answer timer and record them separately. Query encoding and retrieval remain inside the answer timer. Legacy missing setup measurements stay null.
setup_cost_definition: retrieval_setup_latency_ms measures document-vector prewarm in each fresh storage namespace; per_arm_setup_latency_ms adds that arm's corpus clone. upfront_setup_latency_ms additionally includes the shared, amortizable frozen-corpus ingestion cost. Its paired mean describes cold-start-equivalent cost, not total run expenditure: never sum upfront_setup_latency_ms across answers. corpus_ingestion retains each corpus once; setup is local work with real elapsed cost, not free provider tokens.
setup_interpretation: Document-vector prewarm alone averaged 9.06 s OFF and 9.64 s ON per fresh clone; not included in answer latency. Local embedding uses CPU and memory even when provider token cost is zero. Shared ingestion cannot be summed once per answer.

historical_before.finding: The Chinese-only diagnostic query did not retrieve the English papers in either arm; this exposes a cross-language retrieval limitation, not an efficiency win.

pure_chinese_retrieval_diagnostic.interpretation: The availability defect improved from no retrieved sources/no model call to eight sources/one real model call in both arms. The local cross-language repair is shared by OFF and ON, so this is not a helper treatment win. MemGPT evidence here is page 8 baseline/persona evaluation rather than the missing pages 2-4 mechanism; eight sources do not establish complete evidence or a causal chain.

remaining_failures_zh: q08 两边均 50 分：将 GraphRAG 相关工作中对通用 RAG 的介绍误当成 GraphRAG 自己的方法。检索到论文里的文字，不代表归属与上下文正确。
q02 和 q05 的重要机制材料仍未完整进入回答上下文；q05 的一次 ON 提高主要是避免 OFF 的过度断言，而不是新增了完整 gleaning 证据。
关键事实完整性均为 2.667/4，并未随 ON 提升；q07 和中文诊断中的 MemGPT 机制材料仍不完整。
没有实际支持链进入答案，不能声称后台类比、演绎、归纳已证明有效。后续窗口修复必须在单独的新结果中评价。
claims_not_established: Causal answer-quality improvement from background assistance.
Savings in provider tokens or full response latency.
Complete causal chains, verified entailment, or universally accurate citations.
Held-out generalization beyond these familiar papers and questions.
Default-product performance at a 2048-token cap, multi-tenant capacity, production readiness, or RSI.

verification.independent_recalculation: Recomputed all 24 candidate weighted scores from the twelve score files and private mapping, and summed all 26 provider receipts independently; they match metrics.json.
verification.manifest_note: Run configuration records semantic_environment=unrecognized. This label is not proof of disabled retrieval: all twenty-six runtime semantic traces are ready and identify the pinned local E5 model. Preserve the recorded value rather than retroactively rewriting it.
